candidate_program.name: capped_neighborhood_clustering
candidate_program.rationale: Discounts effective conflict count by at most fifteen percent when active rivals conflict among themselves. Reach stays within the root neighborhood; induced-edge enumeration can be quadratic, and clustering need not represent recoverable reward.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree * (1 - 0.15 * min(1, rival_mean_internal_degree / max(1, degree - 1))))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
